core_claim.P: BuilderWallet.init() is permissionless and re-initializable with no access control or one-time guard, and BuilderWallet.sweep(token,to) transfers the wallet's entire ERC20 balance to an arbitrary address gated solely by builderAdmin
core_claim.I: Any deployed/funded BuilderWallet holding ERC20 balances (including CollateralTracker share tokens) intended to custody builder fee value
core_claim.V: An attacker can overwrite builderAdmin via init(attacker) and immediately call sweep(token,attacker) to drain the wallet's ERC20 holdings

distinct_impacts.description: Attacker seizes the builderAdmin role of a BuilderWallet by calling the permissionless init()
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: any attacker can overwrite `builderAdmin` at any time

distinct_impacts.description: Attacker drains any ERC20 held by builder wallets, including CollateralTracker share tokens, via sweep()
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: **Direct theft** of any ERC20 held by builder wallets (including CollateralTracker share tokens).

distinct_impacts.description: Takeover requires no privileges; a single permissionless call suffices
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: **No privileges required**; takeover is a single permissionless call.

distinct_impacts.description: Any deployed or funded builder wallet can be drained
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Any deployed/funded builder wallet can be drained.
